Arrive 5-10 minutes early to settle in and not feel rushed. If you will be more than 10 minutes late, please come to the next event. Door will be locked to prevent interruption.

No recording once sessions begin.Welcome to join the Spring Festival at Urban Yoga from 10-4pm. Food trucks, Vendors and music.
During the breath session I encourage you to trust yourself and I create an environment that helps you to feel comfortable and safe.There is no experience needed and you get to choose how deep you want to go.
Most of the practice focuses on using the breath to slow down to calm the nervous system.
A unique experience that gives you the opportunity to explore the power of the breath in a safe environment. This is a journey using the breath and music. Deep rhythmic breathing with awareness moves energy in the body while tapping into the nervous system creating an expanded state of consciousness. This experience creates undeniable changes in the body and mind. Intuitive rhythmic breathing with the ability to relax and let go can facilitate the body's natural capacity to heal itself. The experience can bring deep insights and clarity.
